description: Defines the structure and valid fields for all roles in Castronegro, including villagers, werewolves, ambiguous, and outsiders.

name.description: Human-readable name of the role (e.g., 'Seer', 'Common Villager').

group.description: Categorical group defining the faction or alignment of the role.

effect.description: Narrative or mechanical description of the role’s powers or behavior.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL pointing to the image associated with this role.

category.description: Fixed value identifying this as a role entity.

assignable.description: Indicates whether this role can be directly assigned to a player.

active.description: Marks if this role is currently active or available for play.
